name: Pasta Primavera
notes: Serve to a hungry crowd who is willing to do dishes for dinner!

ingredients.group: White sauce (about 2 recipes per pound of pasta)

items: Seasoned and sauteed chicken strips (if desired and available)

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.body: Cook and drain the appropriate quantity of pasta.

steps.title: Steam the vegetables
steps.body: Steam and drain the carrots, cauliflower and broccoli.

steps.title: Make the white sauce
steps.body: Whisk together **2 cups water**, **⅓ cup powdered milk**, **¼ cup flour** and chicken base to taste (about 2 recipes per pound of pasta). Cook on medium, stirring occasionally, until thickened, and season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Assemble the plates
steps.body: Place noodles on plates, then vegetables, then white sauce, and top with shredded cheddar and parmesan cheeses, garlic salt, and seasoned and sauteed chicken strips, if desired and available.
